Marta: Heads-up — nightly reconciliation created three reversal memos in NetSuite that don't line up with Stripe. Not sure if it's proration or a replay.
Zane: Which accounts + amounts?
Marta: ACCT-512 ($540), ACCT-771 ($240), ACCT-914 ($165). NetSuite refs: RM-2026-512, RM-2026-771, RM-2026-914. Stripe shows only a prorated invoice for ACCT-512 and no reversal records.
Priya: Paste the billing job log and an example webhook payload please.
Marta: Log: https://logs.example.com/org/finance/2026-03-24/jobs/8901
Marta: Example payload: `{
  "id":"evt_5L9a...",
  "type":"invoice.payment_succeeded",
  "data":{"object":{"id":"in_5L9a...","lines":[{"amount":-540,"description":"proration credit"}]}}
}`
Zane: Quick trace: nightly-report consumes webhooks -> writes a reconciliation batch -> ns-sync materializes adjustments. I see Redis blips at 2026-03-24T02:14Z, which triggered a webhook replay. Our webhook dedupe is based on webhook.id, but the reconciliation adjustment id is built from invoice.number + job_run_id. When replay ran twice it created duplicated adjustment records because job_run_id changed.
Marta: So two different adjustment ids for the same webhook led ns-sync to create an extra reversal memo?
Zane: Yep. The second run created a phantom reversal.
Netsuite-admin: I can set the three reversal memos to Pending Approval and disable auto-posting to GL to stop immediate ledger impact. I did that at 2245001202.
billing-bot: job:billing-report-8901 paused by marta at 2245001205 :ok_hand:
Zane: Proposed immediate actions:
1) Pause the nightly-report job (done).
2) Hotfix ns-sync to derive adjustment id from canonical invoice.id only (hotfix PR in flight).
3) Dry-run reconciliation after deploy before reprocessing webhooks.
4) Requeue only the specific webhook ids (avoid full replay).
Priya: Finance approval: I approve holding posting and voids if required for ACCT-512 > $500 once root cause confirmed. Put hold on ACCT-512 and I'll sign.
Marta: Hold put on ACCT-512 at 2245001220.
Zane: Hotfix PR: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/ns-sync/pulls/419 (patch changes adjustment id to use invoice.id). Local tests pass: duplicate replay no longer creates duplicate reversal.
Netsuite-admin: Saved a temporary saved search for memos created by the nightly-report job and amount > $100, sending alerts to Priya and Marta.
Marta: Dry-run reconcile shows no extra reversals after applying local patch.
Zane: Deploying hotfix to prod now. Requeue command I'll use for the two webhooks: `POST /webhooks/replay {"ids":["evt_5L9a...","evt_5L9b..."]}`
billing-bot: deploy:hotfix/ns-sync-adjustment-id pushed by zane at 2245001285, CI green :rocket:
Netsuite-admin: After replay, I voided the phantom reversal for ACCT-512 and posted the corrected adjustment. Ledger balanced at 2245001299.
Priya: Filing FIN-3470 for root cause + remediation steps. Please include the patch reference and the saved search.
Marta: Filed FIN-3470 and attached logs. Closing once the saved search alert is verified.
Netsuite-admin: Saved search alert delivered to Priya and Marta at 2245001303.
Marta: Thanks team, closing thread.
